description: The sheet's palette chips: bone-white, pale grey, near-black, dark red, deep maroon, black. Pale skin, bone-white hair, black armour / gloves / boots / cape with silver seam trim, dark-red cape lining, a faint rose-red lip paint (v3: 'a fainter red'), a near-black maroon liner contour, dark ash brows, red eyes (the one lit accent), a faint-glow red throat gem; the sword bone-pale with a dark centre vein, black grip, red tassel. v3 adds the authored shadow tones (skin_shadow, bodice_shadow) and the armour plates (armor, armor_trim). v4 warms the skin / skin shadow / scalp part toward the face reference (pale warm grey-mauve).

skin.note: v4 pale warm grey-mauve (artist: v3's 226, 220, 218 read as Blender-default grey). Sampled off design/reference/vampwarrior-v4-face-reference.png: lit skin median rgb 131, 122, 117 = hue 21 deg, saturation 0.11 (11,520 px); the hue / saturation taken, the value kept pale (vampiric pallor)

skin_shadow.note: v4 authored shadow shapes on the skin: the reference's shadow hue (18 deg, saturation 0.15, sampled 3,957 px) one step down from the skin (v3 196, 184, 194 was a cool mauve that read grey on the warm skin)

lips.note: v3 faint rose-red lip paint (v2 was a heavy deep maroon 96, 22, 36)

mouth.note: v3 the mouth line between the lips (inside the mouth), dark maroon

brow.note: v3 painted angled brows, dark ash

hair_part.note: scalp in the centre part (v4: the warm skin a step darker; v3 214, 206, 204)

bodice_shadow.note: v3 authored shadow under the chest on the bodice

armor.note: v3 breastplate / pauldron plates (near-black plate, a step above the bodice)

material.note: v3: the v1 material (v2's fully-rough cel setting undone)
